plan: Given my value of $47, I aim to bid slightly below my value to maximize profit while still having a competitive chance to win. Bidding exactly at my value ($47) or higher would result in no profit if I win. I will bid slightly below my value to account for the possibility of other rational bidders also bidding close to their values. A bid of $46.9 balances the risk of losing with the potential profit if I win.

Given my value of $33, I should bid slightly less than my value to maximize profit if I win. A bid around $32.9 balances winning chances and profit. Assuming rational opponents, they will also bid near their values. Bidding slightly below my value increases profit if I win and minimizes loss if outbid.

A rational strategy involves bidding less than my value to ensure a positive profit if I win.
